verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a roughly 5-minute setup that connects GitHub or GitLab and delivers automated feedback on the first pull request. Its review comments carry file paths and line numbers, and the review summary links to each comment. A community user confirms it reviews PRs at their employer. However, the evidence never explicitly calls it an installable GitHub/GitLab App, and never explicitly says comments appear as native inline review comments on the diff; both are implied, not stated. missing for 10: explicit documentation of installation as a GitHub/GitLab App, explicit confirmation that comments are posted as native inline diff comments, independent hands-on corroboration of review latency.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: Set up Greptile AI code reviews in 5 minutes. Connect GitHub or GitLab, configure review triggers, and get automated feedback on your first pull request.
Every review comment includes a Fix with your Agent button that sends the issue — with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code
A Findings list sorted by severity, with links to each comment.
more often than not it catches real issues and gives the author a chance to reply or fix them before another human reviews the PR.
